# Frontmatter Smoke

Exercises `title`, `author`, and `lang` from the YAML frontmatter.
The PDF's `/Title`, `/Author`, and `/Lang` should reflect these
values — visible via `pdfinfo` and in the XMP metadata.

| Column A | Column B |
| -------- | -------- |
| one      | two      |
| three    | four     |
